reason: Instagram already does the job for me and my friend handles it, so I don't need another channel to feed. Free listing is fine if they load the flyers themselves, but I wouldn't pay for anything now.
objection: 500 people on a waitlist is nothing. How many people actually use this app here? I'm not paying for push to an audience that doesn't exist yet.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the app really live with thousands of active users in my city and people showing up at my door saying they found the night on it.
